name: data-story-studio
description: Build editable local CSV/JSON dashboards and deterministic data-driven MP4 animations with Codex.

defaultPrompt: Build an interactive dashboard from my local CSV file.
Turn my dashboard snapshot into an editable MP4 animation.
interface.longDescription: Turn local CSV or JSON data into interactive dashboards, then render a selected chart as an editable animation with PNG previews and MP4 export. Includes explicit source refresh and provenance. Motion requires Node.js, Canvas and FFmpeg; imported line/table charts are represented as bars. No data connectors, background sync or hosted publishing.
